**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king is slightly exposed and your centralized pieces (like the knight on e4) can deliver check near it, look for forcing moves that improve your piece activity. Nxf6+ improved the knight's position while forcing the king to the edge—a fundamental attacking principle: drive the king to the margin and cut off its escape squares.
